minimization_contract.procedure: scan current hyperedges lexicographically; delete the first edge whose deletion preserves exact SAT and deterministic solver split-depth >=4; restart scan; stop when no single deletion preserves depth >=4
minimization_contract.primary_solver: same smallest-unassigned-variable false-first bounded split solver

first_pivot_sensitivity_contract.HEURISTIC_SENSITIVITY: reported if any forced first pivot lowers depth by >=2 relative to frozen smallest-pivot baseline

scale_suite.edge_sampling: same random.Random(seed) sampling without replacement from lexicographically ordered 3-subsets as V

predeclared_scale_findings.DEPTH_GROWTH_CONTINUES: any scale case requires split depth >=5
predeclared_scale_findings.DEPTH6_RESIDUAL: any scale case remains UNKNOWN at depth budget 6
predeclared_scale_findings.NO_FURTHER_DEPTH_GROWTH_FINITE: all scale cases decided and max depth <=4
predeclared_scale_findings.TREE_SIZE_GROWTH_WITNESS: any case exceeds V maximum of 5 nodes or 2 leaves
